invariant: Move exactly one reviewed leaf Java package under the same source root and rewrite only compiler-attributed package, import, and fully-qualified type spans.

native_model.build_boundary: all eligible standalone Java sources compile without external classpath or build-system evaluation

outcomes.complete: preflight compile, exact after-tree edits, post-move compile, and exact source-diff oracle pass
outcomes.partial: an old package identity remains outside attributed rewrite spans
outcomes.unsupported: tool, directory/package/source-root, generated/vendor/symlink/non-leaf, or destination boundary is outside v1
outcomes.failed: malformed/unresolved source, helper failure, native compile failure, or exact-diff mismatch; post-write failure rolls back

reuse_decision.shared_candidate: JDK compiler bootstrap, path safety, source inventory, and JSON emission
reuse_decision.decision: reuse the proven invocation pattern but not a shared semantic fact schema
reuse_decision.reason: mutation requires exact source spans, dynamic-identity refusal, compile-before/after, and rollback that proposal does not own

product_cost: The Java span helper is 443 lines and the existing mover carries roughly 340 Java-mode/gate lines after closeout. Treat further Java mutation families as demand-triggered until a simplification experiment proves lower maintenance cost without weakening rollback.
next_language_guidance: For a new language mutation pilot, require exact identity spans plus native before/after verification and rollback; do not treat parser success as mutation safety.
